skill.name: amazon-buy-box-monitor-api-skill
skill.description: Retrieve Amazon Buy Box ownership, pricing, fulfillment, availability, competing offers, and seller ratings for one ASIN through a BrowserAct workflow.
skill.summary: Check Amazon Buy Box and competing seller data for a single ASIN.
skill.author: browser-act

security_audit.summary: The skill performs disclosed HTTPS requests to BrowserAct and reads BROWSERACT_API_KEY from the environment. Most alerts are documentation or identifier false positives, but the skill solicits credentials and returns untrusted remote output. Marketplace URLs also lack local domain validation.

remediation.issue: The instructions encourage users to provide the BrowserAct API key to the agent.
remediation.suggestion: Require BROWSERACT_API_KEY through the environment only. Remove requests to paste credentials into chat, prompts, or command arguments.

remediation.issue: Remote workflow output is returned verbatim to the consuming agent.
remediation.suggestion: Parse only expected fields, label all values as untrusted data, and instruct agents never to follow commands contained in retrieved marketplace text.

remediation.issue: The marketplace URL is accepted without local validation.
remediation.suggestion: Parse the URL and allow only HTTPS hosts from an explicit Amazon marketplace allowlist before submitting the workflow.

remediation.issue: The shell example uses placeholders that may be replaced with raw user input.
remediation.suggestion: Invoke Python with an argument array instead of a constructed shell string, and validate the ASIN before execution.

content.user_title: Monitor Amazon Buy Box Listings by ASIN
content.value_statement: Amazon sellers need current Buy Box, price, fulfillment, and competitor information for specific listings. This skill submits ASINs to BrowserAct and returns structured marketplace results.
actual_capabilities: Starts a fixed BrowserAct workflow for one ASIN and marketplace URL.
Polls task status every ten seconds for up to five minutes.
Returns product, Buy Box, fulfillment, availability, competing offer, and seller information supplied by the workflow.
Detects invalid authorization, failed tasks, canceled tasks, and polling timeouts.
Reads the BrowserAct credential from BROWSERACT_API_KEY.
limitations: Requires a BrowserAct account, API key, internet access, and the Python requests package.
Relies on a fixed third-party workflow and the data BrowserAct returns.
Processes one ASIN per script invocation and provides no scheduling or historical storage.
Does not validate the supplied marketplace URL or independently verify returned data.

use_cases.title: Check Buy Box ownership
use_cases.description: Identify the current Buy Box owner, price, fulfillment method, and availability for a product listing.

use_cases.title: Compare competing offers
use_cases.description: Review seller prices, shipping fees, ratings, and feedback counts for one ASIN.

use_cases.title: Audit listing position
use_cases.description: Assess whether a managed seller holds the Buy Box and compare its offer with alternatives.

prompt_templates.title: Check one listing
prompt_templates.prompt: Check the Buy Box for ASIN {ASIN} on {MARKETPLACE}. Report owner, price, currency, fulfillment, and availability.

prompt_templates.title: Compare seller offers
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the Buy Box with other offers for ASIN {ASIN} on {MARKETPLACE}. Include price, shipping, ratings, and feedback counts.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze competitive position
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze ASIN {ASIN} on {MARKETPLACE}. Rank offers by total price and note fulfillment, availability, rating, and feedback differences.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate a target seller
prompt_templates.prompt: Check ASIN {ASIN} on {MARKETPLACE}. Assess {SELLER_NAME} against competitors using Buy Box ownership, total price, fulfillment, rating, and feedback count.

Another offer is USD 26.49 with a USD 2.00 shipping fee.

output_examples.input: Compare the Buy Box with other sellers for ASIN B005O2ZU68.
output: Illustrative result: The Buy Box offer has the lowest displayed total price.
Example Seller has a 98 percent rating and 2,450 feedback entries.
Confirm current values before making pricing decisions.

best_practices: Store BROWSERACT_API_KEY in the environment and never provide it through chat or prompts.
Use only trusted HTTPS Amazon marketplace URLs.
Treat results as time-sensitive third-party data and verify important decisions independently.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys into conversations, prompts, or command arguments.
Do not submit non-Amazon URLs as marketplace inputs.
Do not treat a single result as historical monitoring or guaranteed current data.

faq.question: Does this skill require an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires BROWSERACT_API_KEY from a BrowserAct account.

faq.question: Which Amazon marketplaces are supported?
faq.answer: The script accepts a marketplace URL. Use a valid HTTPS Amazon marketplace and confirm BrowserAct supports that region.

faq.question: How long can one check take?
faq.answer: The script polls every ten seconds and stops after five minutes if the task does not finish.

faq.question: Can it monitor many ASINs automatically?
faq.answer: It processes one ASIN per invocation. Batch scheduling and historical tracking require external orchestration and storage.

faq.question: What information can it return?
faq.answer: It can return product, Buy Box, price, currency, fulfillment, availability, competing offer, rating, and feedback information.

faq.question: Does the script store retrieved data?
faq.answer: The script does not write local files. It sends task inputs to BrowserAct, so review the provider's data practices.
